description: This Java source file defines the RegistrationClientImpl class, which implements methods for interacting with Hono's Device Registration API via AMQP. It includes methods for creating registration requests, asserting device registration, managing AMQP links, and handling responses. The class also supports caching results and creating client instances for specific tenants.

classes.name: RegistrationClientImpl
classes.description: A client implementation for Hono's Device Registration API, handling AMQP communication, registration assertions, response caching, and client creation per tenant.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Returns the AMQP target address for device registration of a specific tenant.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new RegistrationClient for a tenant with optional caching and link handlers.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Initiates a device registration assertion request for a device, optionally including a gatewayId and tracing context.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Processes the response payload from the registration service and converts it to a RegistrationResult object.

methods.name: createDeviceIdProperties
methods.description: Creates a map of properties for device ID to be included in registration requests.
